name: Alleymental
storyline: Alley is a street kid who fights with the Elemental Shroud, a relic his parents built and died protecting. When the closest thing he has to family goes missing, his search uncovers what the old powers of Astrapunk India have kept hidden.
summary: Alleymental is a Metroidvania set in a modern India woven with myth. Master elemental weapons and switch between them mid-combo without breaking your flow. Explore a living Astrapunk India you perma-change as you cross it, uncover hidden fusions, and discover what your parents built and died for.
